button.interactionmanager.item_block_int:
Manage Item-Block interactions
First select an item, then add blocks. That item can't be used on these blocks.
button.interactionmanager.item_deny_list:
Manage Item Deny List
Denied items can't be used, only applies to items that can be used by not clicking a block
button.interactionmanager.block_deny_lis:
Manage block deny list
Deny Listed blocks can't be broken.
button.interactionmanager.entity_deny_li:
Manage entity deny list
Deny Listed entities can't be attacked.
screen.interactionmanager.restore_defaul: Are you sure you'd like to restore default options?
confirm.interactionmanager.restore_defau:
The current options will not be saved!
Your current block and entity denylists won't be cleared.
option.interactionmanager.allow_shovel_c: Toggle shovels creating paths when used on dirt-like blocks
option.interactionmanager.allow_axe_stri: Toggle axes stripping blocks, such as logs
option.interactionmanager.allow_use_fire: Toggle setting off fireworks when used on blocks
option.interactionmanager.allow_dropping:
Toggle dropping items
Does not work in creative
option.interactionmanager.lock_hot_bar.t:
Toggle moving and dropping hot bar items
Does not work in creative
option.interactionmanager.replace_blocks: When enabled after breaking a block the block in the off hand slot will be placed
option.interactionmanager.should_replace: When enabled replacing blocks with the same block is allowed
option.interactionmanager.animate_replac: Show hand swinging animation when replacing blocks
option.interactionmanager.allow_attackin: Toggle the ability to attack and damage other players
Toggle the ability to attack and damage hostile mobs
Toggle the ability to attack and damage passive mobs

Toggle the ability to attack and damage villagers.
If Attack Passive Mobs is OFF this will have no effect.
Toggle the ability to attack and damage vehicles. (Boats, minecarts)
option.interactionmanager.render_items_i: Toggle rendering item icons in the options
option.interactionmanager.pet_attack_mod:
All - you can attack all pets
Only Not Yours - You can attack not tamed pets and other players' pets
Not Tamed - You can only attack not tamed pets
None - You can't attack any tamable mobs
If Attack Passive Mobs is OFF this will have no effect
option.interactionmanager.should_add_int:
Changing NOT recommended!
Add Interactions button in the main menu.
No Mod Menu - Only if Mod Menu is not installed
option.interactionmanager.protect_from_s: When enabled if an attack with sweeping edge would hit a protected entity it'll be canceled
option.interactionmanager.render_protect:
When attacking a protected entity a box will be drawn around it, to indicate that it's protected.
When attacking an entity would cause sweeping edge damage to a protected entity and Sweeping Edge protection is ON a different color box will be drawn around the attacked entity
When looking at a protected block a red outline will be drawn
option.interactionmanager.allow_breaking: Toggle the ability to break blocks
option.interactionmanager.allow_placing_: Toggle the ability to place blocks
option.interactionmanager.allow_opening_:
Toggle the ability to open block GUIs, such as crafting tables and furnaces
Does not affect doors
Toggle the ability to open doors
option.interactionmanager.enable_block_d:
Enabled - You can't break denied blocks
Disabled - You can break denied blocks, unless the 'Break Blocks' option is OFF
option.interactionmanager.enable_entity_:
Enabled - You can't attack denied entities
Disabled - You can attack denied entities, unless they are protected by another option
